items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee's name is Big Chief Moore. The transcript contains only the interviewer mentioning Duke Ellington and his band members. There is no statement from the interviewee indicating any personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: Yes, yes, yes. One time I was walking the streets, and I picked up a circular, and it said, 'now appearing at' such-and-such a place, I forgot where they were appearing,
"Duke Ellington and his Washingtonians". And there was Sonny Greer and . . .
